properties.m_Description: Mask R-mod main G-mask B-mod mask

coordinate_conversion: Godot position=(x,y,-z); rotation=S*R*S; normals=S*n; triangle order a,c,b; raw source UV retained until final texture sampling flips V after ST.
limitations: Static MeshRenderer scene only; no ParticleSystem or PlayMaker simulation, no audio, no SkinnedMeshRenderer pose synthesis.
Runtime lighting globals/keywords require explicit compatibility classification; source serialized values are not assumed final framebuffer parity.
Original source build is modern37.0, not proof of pixel identity to historic55s reference video.
